718020201.text: These are indeed the blueprints for my Dwelling in the Clouds. One is most pleased.

718020202.text: You still haven't said what you're gonna—

718020203.text: Must you continue to question me? *sigh* Very well, considering you did make an offering...

718020204.text: One has heard of a certain Jade Chamber that hangs in the air above Liyue, built by mortal hands.

718020205.text: One has also heard that mortals value size above all else, and have on this basis proceeded to declare that said chamber is without parallel in all the world.

718020206.text: Hmph! Such are the limits of mortal comprehension, that they fail to fathom the ingenuity of the adepti.

718020207.text: Jade Chamber my foot! A glimpse at the most trivial of my mechanical accomplishments would reveal the Jade Chamber to be an utterly tedious and mundane piece of work...

718020209.text: Nonsense! I am no loser, nor am I afflicted with sores... I merely pity the foolish! These mortals, blind to adepti ingenuity, bedazzled by the crudest of craftsmanship...

718020210.text: I fear that this will cause mechanics among mortals to develop in a woefully mistaken direction. It falls to me to point them down the right path.

718020211.text: The matter at hand is concluded. Leave at once.

718020301.text: State your business at once! One has a myriad matters to which one must attend. Waste not the valuable time of an adeptus!

718020302.text: Just wanted to see how you're doing...

718020304.text: Your business is a novel one... You simply came to wish me well, and not to fulfill a wish of some other nature?

718020305.text: Very well, so be it! Mortal minds work in mysterious ways... I have no interest in attempting to understand them.

718020306.text: Since you are so demonstrably idle at present... Would you care to do me a small favor?

718020307.text: Once upon a time, when I had made a modest breakthrough in my mechanical studies, I built for myself a Dwelling in the Clouds suspended in the air.

718020308.text: This Dwelling in the Clouds was built principally from plaustrite, supported by a multitude of other ingenious features... In fact, its most marvelous feature of all was, was... Never mind, you would not understand even if I explained it.

718020309.text: After construction of the Dwelling in the Clouds was complete, I left the blueprints there.

718020310.text: I also added a seal, thinking that one of true affinity with the blueprints might eventually obtain them. But no — to this day, the seal stands.

718020311.text: It now seems a needless bother to me to have the blueprints stored there. Perhaps you can retrieve them from the Dwelling in the Clouds for me.

718020313.text: Such enthusiasm. Then do not delay, deliver them to my abode when you have found them, for that is where I shall be waiting for you.

718020315.text: Naturally, I have my reasons. But please, do not presume that you could scrutinize an idea conceived in the mind of an adeptus.

718020316.text: Delay no further. Deliver them to my abode when you have found them, for that is where I shall be waiting for you.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the adeptus' abode and search for the blueprints
Give the blueprints to Cloud Retainer

718020501.text: I see you have obtained the blueprints. Now, hand them to me forthwith!

subQuests.subQuestName: Place the blueprints before Cloud Retainer

718020401.text: You still have not obtained the blueprints? But they are right there, in the Dwelling in the Clouds...

718020402.text: Ugh, how'd she know we hadn't fetched them yet?

718020403.text: Those blueprints are a work of my own hand, should I not be able to sense when they are in my presence? Now, fetch them forthwith!

718021001.text: To seek the adepti in Jueyun is no mean feat. Still, you have come forth...

718021002.text: Whoa! D—Didn't she already go to Liyue Harbor? Did she sneak back here while we weren't looking?

718021003.text: Her voice... doesn't sound quite right.

718021004.text: Uh, so, we were just worried that someone might steal stuff from your place. We didn't mean to disturb you.

718021005.text: ...One has a task you might perform. Perform it well, and access to one's abode shall be granted.

718021008.text: Err, so you mean that this isn't her we're talking to, but some sorta machine she left behind?

718021009.text: Once upon a time, when one had made a modest breakthrough in my mechanical studies, one built for oneself a Dwelling in the Clouds suspended in the air.

718021010.text: And when said Dwelling was completed, one thought upon the rarity of meeting an adeptus, and there one left the blueprint, for some fated person to take them.

718021011.text: Retrieve the blueprint before entering one's abode once more. We shall speak more at that time.

718021013.text: Cloud Retainer? Xian... Err, Ms. Xianyun...?

718021014.text: Retrieve the blueprint to complete this task, and then one's abode once more. We shall speak more at that time.

718021015.text: On and on she goes, without paying attention to us at all, huh?

718021101.text: Once upon a time, when one had made a modest breakthrough in my mechanical studies, one built for oneself a Dwelling in the Clouds suspended in the air.

718021102.text: And when said Dwelling was completed, one thought upon the rarity of meeting an adeptus, and there one left the blueprint, for some fated person to take them.

718021103.text: Retrieve the blueprint before entering one's abode once more. We shall speak more at that time.

718021201.text: The blueprints you have retrieved, adeptal fate you have received. Come hither and seek your audience.

718021301.text: ...Errr, what is this? It's a table... and a box on top of it, and nothing else anywhere!

718021304.text: You have reached this place, and one knows already your heart...

718021306.text: Pen down your wish, and consign it to the chest. One shall make the final decision.

718021307.text: Dangers you have braved with an unwavering will — a rare gift indeed. Take, then, these treasures with you.

718021308.text: Woohoo! Hehe, Paimon knew you wouldn't let us come away empty-handed!

718021309.text: Still, this voice says, "Pen down your wish, and consign it to the chest." Guess we just write our wish down and put it in?
